$comment: AHSP Bina Marga item catalogue for the PAVEMENT-PINN fair-cost engine. Official coefficients have NOT been retrieved: every official coefficient is null with status TODO_VERIFY and the sheet to fetch. Coefficients found in published studies are kept separately under reference_coefficients with status ASSUMED and must never be shown as official. See 06_COST_ENGINE.md.

statuses.OFFICIAL: Taken from the regulation or SE sheet itself.
statuses.ASSUMED: From a published study or another region/year; used only as a labelled proxy.
statuses.TODO_VERIFY: Not yet retrieved; source_to_fetch names the document.

method.regulation: Permen PUPR No. 8 Tahun 2023 (Pedoman Penyusunan Perkiraan Biaya Pekerjaan Konstruksi)
method.technical_annex: SE Dirjen Bina Konstruksi No. 30/SE/Dk/2025, Lampiran V (AHSP Bidang Bina Marga) - replaces SE 73/2023 annexes

changes: Fog Seal D.1-D.3 emulsion coefficients changed
Lampiran VII now refers to Perpres 180/2024 and Permen PU 1/2024
annex_facts.source: Kaltim DPUPR-PERA training 'Pengantar Permen PUPR 08/23 & SE Dirjen Binkons 30/25' https://sibikon-dpuprpera.kaltimprov.go.id/download-materi-acara/PengantarPermenPUPR0823_SEDirjenBinkons3025

method.source_to_fetch: SE 30/SE/Dk/2025 Lampiran V Excel - simantu.pu.go.id / binakonstruksi.pu.go.id / bit.ly/SEDJBKAHSP (per note 06)
method.formula: HSP = (sum(labor_coef*wage) + sum(material_coef*price) + sum(equipment_coef*rate)) * (1 + OHP); estimate = sum(HSP_i * Q_i) + SMKK; total = estimate * (1 + PPN_eff)

ohp_default.source: SE Dirjen Bina Marga No. 01/SE/Db/2019 (10% cap for Bina Marga items) as cited in Kaltim training (SE 30/25); both academic RABs used 10%

ohp_max.source: Permen PUPR 8/2023 Pasal 11(3): 'dihitung sebesar 10% hingga 15% dari biaya langsung'
ohp_max.note: Conflict with the 10% cap in Bina Marga training. Engine: default 10%, admin may set up to 15%; any HPS > 15% flagged non-compliant.

ohp_lump_sum.source: Permen PUPR 8/2023 Pasal 4(3) (lump-sum unit prices exclude biaya tidak langsung), quoted in Kaltim training materi-8

ppn_dpp_factor.source: PMK 131/2024 Pasal 3 (DPP nilai lain for non-luxury goods/services)

ppn_effective.note: Article does not explicitly mention jasa konstruksi / government procurement; a 2026 'PMK omnibus' revised DPP nilai lain rules - content not fetched (TODO_VERIFY).

working_days_per_month.source: Lampiran Permen PUPR 1/2022 (AHSP Bidang Umum); AHSP Bina Marga Bagian III says 24-26

effective_hours_per_day.source: Lampiran Permen PUPR 1/2022 (8 h minus 1 h rest)

wage_basis.rule: UMP or UMK 'di luar pajak' = upah pokok + tunjangan; hourly rate at least UMP/175
wage_basis.source: Permen PUPR 8/2023 Pasal 7(1)(a)-(3); Lampiran Permen PUPR 1/2022 formula (1)

equipment_management_factor.source: Kaltim training materi-8 (50 effective minutes per hour)

modified_hotmix_fuel_factor.source: Kaltim training materi-8 ('about 1.5x the fuel of normal hot mix')

smkk.rule: paid as a separate pokok pekerjaan

crew_rules.rule: Crew-hours come from coefficients x quantity, not fixed headcounts.

item_list_source.title: AHSP Bidang Bina Marga Bagian III (item list aligned to Spesifikasi Umum 2018 Revisi 2), hosted by Disperkimhub Wonosobo, uploaded 2022-06-08
item_list_source.caveat: The file does not state its Permen number (companion file is Lampiran Permen PUPR 1/2022). Codes may have been renumbered/added by Permen 8/2023 + SE 73/2023 / SE 30/2025 - every code has code_status TODO_VERIFY until checked against SE 30/2025 Lampiran V. The source lists 11.1.(4) twice (Timbunan Pilihan pada Lereng and LPA Kelas A) - numbering error in the source.
item_list_source.spec_note: Cite Spesifikasi Umum 2018 Rev 2 Divisi 11 (Pemeliharaan) / Seksi 11.1 - NOT 'Divisi 8 Pengembalian Kondisi' (Spec 2010 Rev 3 name).

Loss factor (faktor kehilangan) and berat isi used inside the sheet

items.name: Lapis Perekat (tack coat), Aspal Cair/Emulsi

application_rate_l_per_m2.note: Spec rate not retrieved; Kota Bekasi method statement says rate is set by an on-site 'paper test'. The repo's config/prices/jabodetabek.json tackCoatKgPerM2 = 0.25 is an unsourced assumption - do not carry it over as official.

Laston Lapis Aus (AC-WC)

min_thickness_cm.source: Bina Marga SKh-1.6.27 (2019) cross-referencing Spec 2018 (OCR rendered units as mm; values match cm thickness / mm tolerance) https://binamarga.pu.go.id/uploads/files/1825/preview_1825-1-5.pdf ; same values in BPK Perwakilan Malut Buku Saku https://malut.bpk.go.id/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/BUKU-SAKU-PEMERIKSAAN-PENGUJIAN-FISIK-PEKERJAAN-KONSTRUKSI-JALAN_SAKINAH-KAMARUDDIN.pdf

official.source_to_fetch: SE 30/SE/Dk/2025 Lampiran I/II Tabel A.2.d (9 rows)

assumed_range.source: Field core densities: AC-BC 2.29-2.34 g/cm3 (PNJ CMJ, Padang-Pekanbaru toll https://jurnal.pnj.ac.id/index.php/cmj/article/view/7938); AC-WC field 2.25 vs lab 2.27 g/cc (Unibos 2026 https://journal.unibos.ac.id/jptsk/article/view/5104)

faktor_kehilangan.note: Inside official item coefficients already. Only the per-ton fallback route needs it; until loaded the engine uses 1.00 and warns.

cut_margin_m.note: 'about 30 cm into sound pavement' is common practice (note 07), NOT verified in Spec 2018 Rev 2 Seksi 11.1 - never show as official.
cut_margin_m.source_to_fetch: Spesifikasi Umum 2018 Revisi 2 Divisi 11 Seksi 11.1 (Pengukuran & Pembayaran)

cut_shape.note: Standard practice; Spec text not retrieved.

compaction_density_min_pct.source: Spesifikasi Umum 2018 rev. 2 as cited in PNJ core-drill study (AC-BC >= 98%)
compaction_density_min_pct.note: Lab test - recommended to the agency, not claimed by the app.
